class.name: IcyMp3AudioDecoder
class.brief_description: Audio decoder implementation for MP3 streams.
class.description: [IcyMp3AudioDecoder] implements live decoding of MP3 streams. It is registered with [method IcyAudioDecoder.create_for_mime_type] under [code]audio/mpeg[/code], [code]audio/mp3[/code], [code]audio/x-mpeg[/code] and [code]audio/mpeg3[/code]. Buffering, the bitrate hint, stream information and all signals are provided by [IcyAudioDecoder]. This class only contains the codec (the low-level decoder of dr_mp3, which is minimp3). It decodes one MP3 frame per call and reports the channel count, sample rate and bitrate of every frame. Xing/Info tags at the start of a relayed file and format changes during the stream are handled like any other frame.
